name: Material 3
summary: An adaptive and expressive system built from semantic color roles, a named type hierarchy, shape, and component theming that can change character without losing structural consistency.
signature_traits: named type scale from display to label
theme subsystems for color typography and shape
best_for: cross-platform systems that need strong theming
consumer products where color and shape carry identity
avoid_for: products that copy the baseline purple palette without brand reasoning
dense technical tools where oversized expressive surfaces reduce usable information density
